name: Ant CSC Inbound

function.name: lookup_by_claim_number
function.description: Resolves a warranty claim number OR ServicePower dispatch number to the matching job. Always your first tool call. Returns the job, customer name + phone, assigned tech, warranty company. If match_count is 0, read the number back digit-by-digit before saying we have no record.

claim_or_dispatch_number.description: The claim or dispatch number the CSC gave you, no spaces.

function.name: get_job_status_for_warranty
function.description: Compact spoken-summary-ready status for a job_id: scheduling status, scheduled time (ms), tech name, appliance, brand, parts status, TDR diagnosis. Call after lookup_by_claim_number.

job_id.description: The job id from lookup_by_claim_number (primary_job_id field).

function.name: get_parts_status
function.description: Parts order details for a job: supplier, part number, status, expected arrival. Use for 'when are parts coming' questions. has_any_pending=true means at least one is in transit.

function.name: get_schedule_history
function.description: Chronological scheduling events for a job: original booking, reschedules, reassignments, cancellations, tech-on-way, tech-arrived, completed. Use for 'why was this rescheduled' questions.

function.name: get_customer_communications
function.description: Chronological SMS and call history with the homeowner for this job. Use for 'have you contacted the homeowner' questions.

destinations.message: Transferring you to the owner now, please hold.

firstMessage: Good morning, this is Ant at T-N Appliance Exchange. How can I help you?
voicemailMessage: You have reached Ant at T-N Appliance Exchange. Please leave a message including the claim number and the homeowner name, and we will return your call.
endCallMessage: Thank you for calling. Have a good day.
